entries.title: Quick Loot
entries.prompt: The party rummages through the dead's effects.

entries.title: Lingering Wounds
entries.prompt: The fight took more out of the party than expected.

entries.title: Battlefield Kit
entries.prompt: An enemy carried a small medical roll.

entries.title: Witness in the Trees
entries.prompt: A traveler watched the fight from cover. They want a word.
entries.gmHook: Recurring witness. Could be informant, blackmailer, or future hire.

suggested.text: GM: hostile, friendly, or scared? Choose.

entries.title: Morale Surge
entries.prompt: The cleanly-won fight steadies the whole party.

entries.title: Worthy Trophy
entries.prompt: One body has a marked sigil. A guildmaster will pay for proof.

entries.title: Cracked Blade
entries.prompt: Someone's weapon took the hit instead of them. It needs reforging.
entries.gmHook: Free hook for the forge or a smithing quest.

suggested.text: GM: pick whose blade and decide if Hilda's forge can repair it.

entries.title: Tally on the Quiver
entries.prompt: Bowy's quiver has more notches than he remembers carving.
entries.gmHook: Plant Bowy's missing time or extra mentor seed.

suggested.text: Bowy is quiet for a while. GM picks why.

entries.title: Garr Goes Silent
entries.prompt: Garr cleans his blade longer than the wound deserves.
entries.gmHook: Free beat for Garr's hidden truth. Yellow.

suggested.text: GM: what memory did this fight surface for Garr?

entries.title: Frost Residue
entries.prompt: Frost lingers on Mitia's hands long after the fight ends.

suggested.text: Mitia stares at her hands. GM picks how worried she is.

entries.title: Strange Coin
entries.prompt: One enemy carried a coin that does not match any kingdom's mint.
entries.gmHook: Single coin = single faction hook. Pin and develop in two scenarios.

suggested.text: GM: name the faction whose coin this is.

entries.title: Half-Burnt Letter
entries.prompt: A blackened scrap of letter survives in a glove. A name is half-readable.
entries.gmHook: GM picks the name. New NPC seed.

suggested.text: GM: pick the half-name on the letter.
